decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-09-14
decision_details_body:
- the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health to declare the period from 03rd to 09th October 2011 as the National Health Week and to conduct a series of programmes in the country during this period, in  
	collaboration with relevant stakeholders, was approved by the Cabinet.
